intro.text: Spren that appear around music, as spinning, see-through ribbons whirling around the instrument.

description.text: A single pure note can draw one, if only briefly.
They also seem drawn to Ryshadium, so they may be the spren the horses bond.

items.text: In Shadesmar, musicspren resemble horses made of air and let their Ryshadium gallop briefly through the air.
